examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
seyyathā'pi nāma saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
tassa ce kāmayānassa, chandajātassa jantuno, te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.

68004.meaning1: destroyed; demolished; crumbled to pieces; collapsed; ruined

examples.text: upāyāsā ca te sabbe, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā, sītibhūto damappatto, dhitimā saccanikkamo.
chinnaṃ pāpimato sotaṃ, viddhastaṃ vinaḷīkataṃ, pāmojjabahulā hotha, khemaṃ patt'attha bhikkhavo'ti.
yathā, mahārāja, vāri pokkharapatte vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃsati na saṇṭhāti na upalimpati.
ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummās'upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

68008.meaning1: subject to falling apart; liable to destruction
68008.meaning2: subject to falling apart; liable to destruction
68008.commentary: (DNa) anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo'ti hutvā abhāv'aṭṭhena aniccadhammo. duggandhavighāt'atthāya tanuvilepanena ucchādanadhammo. aṅgapaccaṅg'ābādha-vinodan'atthāya khuddakasambāhanena parimaddanadhammo. daharakāle vā ūrūsu sayāpetvā gabbhāvāsena dussaṇṭhitānaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ aṅgānaṃ saṇṭhānasampādan'atthaṃ añchana-pīḷan'ādi-vasena parimaddanadhammo. evaṃ pariharito'pi bhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo bhijjati c'eva vikirati ca, evaṃ sabhāvo'ti attho.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo. idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti.

vivaṭan'ti taṇhāchadanaṃ diṭṭhichadanaṃ kilesachadanaṃ duccaritachadanaṃ avijjāchadanaṃ. tāni chadanāni vivaṭāni honti viddhaṃsitāni ugghāṭitāni samugghāṭitāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabb'uppattikāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni.
māramasanā'ti khandhamār'ādayo pañcamāre masati parāmasati viddhaṃsetī'ti māramasano.

68015.grammar: idiom, adj + adj + masc, loc abs
68015.meaning1: in a clear cloudless sky; when the sky is clear and cloudless

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

68016.meaning1: who is wise; who is knowing; who is intelligent

examples.text: evaṃvihārī sato appamatto, bhikkhu caraṃ hitvā mamāyitāni, jātiṃ jaraṃ sokapariddavañ'ca, idh'eva vidvā pajaheyya dukkhaṃ.
sayaṃ samādāya vatāni jantu, ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto, vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ, na ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño.

68017.meaning1: of the kind; of the sort; of the variety; -fold

examples.text: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

satt'ime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti na vipariṇamanti na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.
anāpatti gaṇṭhikāya, araṇike, vidhe, añjaniyā, añjanisalākāya, vāsijaṭe, udakapuñchaniyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

68020.commentary: (SNa) vikiratī'ti ayogena vaḷañjento vippakirati. vidhamatī'ti dhamento viya nāseti. viddhaṃsetī'ti nāseti.

examples.text: saṅkhāre vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha. viññāṇaṃ vikiratha vidhamatha viddhaṃsetha vikīḷaniyaṃ karotha taṇhākkhayāya paṭipajjatha. taṇhākkhayo hi, rādha, nibbānan'ti.

yathā vā pana, mahārāja… padīpo andhakāravidhamanāya, vāto pariḷāhanibbāpanāya, sippaṃ vuttinipphādanāya, agadaṃ jīvitarakkhaṇāya, ākaro ratan'uppādanāya, ratanaṃ alaṅ'karāya, āṇā anatikkamanāya, issariyaṃ vasavattanāya…

68024.meaning2: having destroyed, having ruined, having scattered

examples.text: titthiye nihanitvāna, mārañ'cā'pi sasenakaṃ, tam'andhakāraṃ vidhamitvā, dhammanagaraṃ amāpayi.

kathaṃ, bhante, obhāsanalakkhaṇā paññā'ti? paññā, mahārāja, uppajjamānā avijj'andhakāraṃ vidhameti, vijj'obhāsaṃ janeti, ñāṇ'ālokaṃ vidaṃseti, ariyasaccāni pākaṭāni karoti. tato yog'āvacaro aniccan'ti vā dukkhan'ti vā anattā'ti vā sammappaññāya passatī'ti.
evaṃ pamatto rasagārave ratto, bālo yadī āyati n'āvabujjhati, vidhamma putte caji ñātake ca, parivattiya attānam'eva khādati.
duggat'āhaṃ pure āsiṃ, vidhavā ca aputtikā, vinā mittehi ñātīhi, bhattacoḷassa n'ādhigaṃ.
katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārikāgocaro vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.

68029.meaning1: having destroyed; having demolished; having crushed

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā anādiyitvā sārathiṃ anādiyitvā patodalaṭṭhiṃ dantehi mukh'ādhānaṃ vidhaṃsitvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.

68030.commentary: (SNa) tīsu vidhāsū'ti tīsu mānesu… tisso imā, bhikkhave, vidhā. katamā tisso? seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā'ti
68030.notes: tisso vidhā 1. seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 2. sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 3. hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā

examples.text: samo visesī uda vā nihīno, yo maññatī so vivadetha tena, tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno, samo visesī'ti na tassa hoti.

dukkhe anattasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.

68031.synonym: kaṇḍa, koṭṭhāsa, pada, padesa, bhāga, sambhāra

examples.text: vaṭṭani'r'iva koṭar'ohitā, majjhe pubbuḷakā sāssukā, pīḷakoḷikā c'ettha jāyati, vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca piṇḍitā.

68032.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from vidahati (+gen)

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ
paññavā buddhisampanno, vidhānavidhikovido, kālaññū samayaññū ca, sa rājavasatiṃ vase.

68037.notes: tisso vidhā 1. seyyo'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 2. sadiso'ham'asmī'ti vidhā, 3. hīno'ham'asmī'ti vidhā

examples.text: dukkhe anattasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'āpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.

68040.meaning1: roams around; wanders about; runs astray; is scattered
68040.commentary: (SNa) vidhāvatī'ti parasamudd'ādigamanavasena ito c'ito ca vidhāvati. (SNt) vidhāvatī'ti vividhaṃ rūpaṃ padhāvati, yathākāmaṃ pavattatī'ti attho.

examples.text: yena sallena otiṇṇo, disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam'eva sallam'abbuyha, na dhāvati na sīdati.
taṇhā janeti purisaṃ, cittam'assa vidhāvati, satto saṃsāram'āpādi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayan'ti.

68041.meaning1: fans out; spreads out; flows out; goes (in)

examples.text: tathāgatena hi, bhikkhave, arahatā sammāsambuddhena purisadammo sārito aṭṭha disā vidhāvati.

68044.commentary: (THa) tena tenā ti tena tena ārammaṇabhāgena. vidhāvitā'ti virūpaṃ dhāvitā asāruppavasena paṭipajjantā.

examples.text: kileseh'ābhibhūtā te, tena tena vidhāvitā, narā kilesavatthūsu, sasaṅgāme'va ghosite.

68045.meaning1: having run about; having raced around

examples.text: ādhāvitvā vidhāvitvā kīḷanakāle pana lobhanīyavayasmiṃ vā ṭhitakāle dārakaṃ oloketvā mātāpitūnaṃ cittaṃ sappimaṇḍe pakkhittasatavihatakappāsapicupaṭalaṃ viya mudukaṃ hoti āmoditaṃ pamoditaṃ, tadā tesaṃ muditā labbhati.

68049.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of vidhi
68049.meaning2: in due method; by means of

examples.text: sakuṇo yathā paṃsukunthito, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajaṃ, evaṃ bhikkhu padhānavā satimā, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajan'ti.

68054.meaning1: having shaken off; having shaken loose; having removed

examples.text: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ ten'eva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñ'c'āpi so evaṃ vadeyya, tath'ev'āyaṃ gāvī saṃyuttā iminā'va cammenā'ti, atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā ten'eva cammenā'ti.

68055.meaning1: name of one of Kakusandha Buddha's chief disciples

examples.text: yāvatā kho pana, pāpima, kakusandhassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakā, tesu na ca koci āyasmatā vidhurena samasamo hoti yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya. iminā kho evaṃ, pāpima, pariyāyena āyasmato vidhurassa vidhuro't'eva samaññā udapādi.

68057.meaning1: Vidhura and Sañjīva; Kakusandha Buddha's pair of chief disciples

examples.text: kakusandhassa kho pana, pāpima, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhurasañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

68059.commentary: (VINa) vidhūtikā'ti sūciyā vā salākāya vā sinduvārapupph'ādīni vijjhitvā katā.

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.

68064.commentary: (VINa) tena ariyamaggena vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ kāmā te paṭhamā senā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttappakāraṃ mārasenaṃ vidhūpayanto vidhamento viddhaṃsento tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ, sūriyo'va obhāsayam'antalikkhan'ti.

68065.meaning1: dispersed; dispelled; scattered; exorcised; (comm) destroyed; set fire to
68065.notes: (Ñāṇananda) Fragrant incense powder is used for the propitiation of gods, while caustic types are used for exorcising evil spirits. So vidhūpita could mean 'smoking out' or 'expelling' of thoughts in this context.

examples.text: pahīnamānassa na santi ganthā, vidhūpitā mānaganth'assa sabbe, sa vītivatto maññataṃ sumedho, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyya, loke samaññaṃ kusalo viditvā vohāramattena so vohareyyā'ti.
yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

68067.notes: (Ñāṇananda) 'exorcises' It is likely that the two words imply two functions of the ritual associated with incense. While some fragrant kinds of incense are used for propitiating benevolent spirits, certain caustic types are utilized for exorcising evil spirits.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti no ācināti, pajahati no upādiyati, visineti no ussineti, vidhūpeti no sandhūpeti

68069.meaning1: having dispersed; having scattered smoke; having exorcised
68069.meaning2: having flavoured, having fanned, having fumigated, having scattered

examples.text: kiñ'ca n'eva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito? rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṃkhare… viññāṇaṃ n'eva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito
saṅkhāya lokasmi paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.
bhavati parijan'assavo vidheyyo, mah'imaṃ āvasito susaṅgahito, piyavadū hitasukhataṃ jigīsamāno, abhirucitāni guṇāni ācarati.

68075.meaning1: destroyed; ruined; (comm) eaten by termites etc.

examples.text: niṭṭhitacīvarasmin'ti bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvar'āsā vā upacchinnā.
anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. adaḍḍhe daḍḍhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

68079.commentary: (AP) supaṇṇamātā vinatā (APt) dvayaṃ garuḷānaṃ mātari. vino pakkhino namanti yaṃ vinatā

examples.text: vinatāya apaccaṃ venateyyo, ikārass'ekāro vuddhi, rohiṇiyā putto rohiṇeyyo, gaṅgāya apaccaṃ gaṅgeyyo, bhaginiyā putto bhāgineyyo, nadiyāputto nādeyyo. evaṃ anteyyo, āheyyo, kāmeyyo. suciyā apaccaṃ soceyyo, ettha ukārassokāro vuddhi, bālāya apaccaṃ bāleyyo iccādi.evaṃ

68085.meaning2: having encircled, having twisted round, having intertwined

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hoti?
eso dhammo eso vinayo etaṃ satthusāsanan'ti

68087.meaning1: monastic law; code of monastic disciplinary rules

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.
paṇḍitā h'āvuso manussā vīmaṃsakā kismiṃ pan'āyasmantānaṃ chandarāgavinayakkhāyī satthā'ti
ath'āparaṃ pañca rajāni loke, yesaṃ satīmā vinayāya sikkhe, rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, gandhesu phassesu sahetha rāgaṃ.
uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

68090.meaning1: talk about monastic law; discussion about monastic discipline

68091.meaning1: legal act; legal action; disciplinary procedure

68092.meaning1: legal act in accordance with the discipline

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, visamā parisā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ adhammakammāni pavattanti dhammakammāni nappavattanti, avinayakammāni pavattanti vinayakammāni nappavattanti, adhammakammāni dippanti dhammakammāni na dippanti, avinayakammāni dippanti vinayakammāni na dippanti.

68093.commentary: (NIDD2) ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabban'ti sabbaṃ ādānataṇhaṃ vinayeyya paṭivinayeyya pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyyā'ti, ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabbaṃ.

examples.text: n'ete kāmā yāni citrāni loke, saṅkapparāgo purisassa kāmo, tiṭṭhanti citrāni tath'eva loke. ath'ettha dhīrā vinayanti chandan'ti.
ādānataṇhaṃ vinayetha sabbaṃ, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, yaṃ yañ'hi lokasmim'upādiyanti, ten'eva māro anveti jantuṃ.
tattha añño bhikkhu āgacchati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito byatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
dullabho, bhikkhave, vuḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.

68095.meaning1: fact of being expert in monastic law
68095.construction:
vinaya + dhara + ka + tta
vinayadharaka + tta

examples.text: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharakattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.

68096.meaning1: fact of being expert in monastic law

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi vinayadharo, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na vinayadharā'ti. so tena vinayadharattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
sappuriso ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho vinayadharattena lobhadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, dosadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, mohadhammā vā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

68098.meaning1: learning of monastic law; studying the rules of monastic discipline
68098.commentary: (VINa) vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsatī'ti vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇantānaṃ vinayapariyattimūlakaṃ vaṇṇaṃ guṇaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ bhāsati.

68099.meaning2: code of discipline for the Buddhist monks

examples.text: atha kho tiṃsamattā pāveyyakā [pāṭheyyakā (katthaci) vinayapiṭake mahāvagge kathinakkhandhake'pi] bhikkhū sabbe āraññikā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbe sasaṃyojanā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

yadi, bhante nāgasena, bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ tathāgatappavedito, bhikkhave, dhammavinayo vivaṭo virocati no paṭicchanno'ti, tena hi pātimokkh'uddeso kevalañ'ca vinayapiṭakaṃ pihitaṃ paṭicchannan'ti yaṃ vacanaṃ, taṃ micchā.
